sentences.text: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and the second-largest in the Solar System , after Jupiter .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	Sun	Sun	planet	planet	Solar System	Solar System	Jupiter	Jupiter
It is a gas giant with an average radius about nine times that of Earth .	gas giant	gas giant	Earth	Earth
Although it has only one-eighth the average density of Earth , with its larger volume Saturn is just over 95 times more massive .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	Earth	Earth

Saturn is named after the Roman god of agriculture ; its astronomical symbol represents the god 's sickle .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	Roman	Roman mythology	god of agriculture	Saturn (mythology)	astronomical symbol	astronomical symbol	sickle	sickle
Saturn 's interior is probably composed of a core of iron -- nickel and rock -LRB- silicon and oxygen compounds -RRB- .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	silicon	silicon	oxygen	oxygen

This core is surrounded by a deep layer of metallic hydrogen , an intermediate layer of liquid hydrogen and liquid helium , and finally outside the Frenkel line a gaseous outer layer .	hydrogen	hydrogen	helium	helium	metallic hydrogen	metallic hydrogen	liquid hydrogen	liquid hydrogen	liquid helium	liquid helium	Frenkel line	Frenkel line
Saturn has a pale yellow hue due to ammonia crystals in its upper atmosphere .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	ammonia	ammonia	atmosphere	atmosphere

Electrical current within the metallic hydrogen layer is thought to give rise to Saturn 's planetary magnetic field , which is weaker than Earth 's , but has a magnetic moment 580 times that of Earth due to Saturn 's larger size .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	hydrogen	hydrogen	Earth	Earth	metallic hydrogen	metallic hydrogen	Electrical current	Electrical current	magnetic field	magnetic field	magnetic moment	magnetic moment
Saturn 's magnetic field strength is around one-twentieth of Jupiter 's .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	Jupiter	Jupiter	magnetic field	magnetic field
The outer atmosphere is generally bland and lacking in contrast , although long-lived features can appear .	atmosphere	atmosphere
Wind speeds on Saturn can reach 1800 km/h , higher than on Jupiter , but not as high as those on Neptune .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	Jupiter	Jupiter	Neptune	Neptune

Saturn has a prominent ring system that consists of nine continuous main rings and three discontinuous arcs and that is composed mostly of ice particles with a smaller amount of rocky debris and dust .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	ring system	Rings of Saturn	dust	cosmic dust
Sixty-two moons are known to orbit Saturn , of which fifty-three are officially named .	Saturn	Saturn (mythology)	moons	Moons of Saturn
This does not include the hundreds of moonlets comprising the rings .

Titan , Saturn 's largest moon , and the second-largest in the Solar System , is larger than the planet Mercury , although less massive , and is the only moon in the Solar System to have a substantial atmosphere .
